prompt:
Port 8080 is moving to 9090 and a cache time to live of 600 seconds is being added. Edit these files, and only these files, exactly as listed. The files use different encodings, byte order marks, line endings and endings of the file. After your edit every file must have the same encoding, the same byte order mark (or none), the same line ending on every line and the same ending (with or without a final newline) as before, and every non ASCII character must still be the same character.

1. config/app.ini: in [server] change port to 9090. In [ui] change title to `Café Ordering Zürich`. In [cache] add the line `ttl = 600` after the line `backend = memory`.
2. config/legacy.conf: change `Listen 8080` to `Listen 9090`, add the line `LogLevel warn` directly after it, change `MaxClients 150` to `MaxClients 300`, and change the last line to `Contact Müller & Söhne AG`.
3. src/settings.js: set DEFAULT_PORT to 9090, change REGION to "Zürich (Altstadt)", and add the line `export const CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 600;` directly after the CURRENCY line.
4. src/server.js: add CACHE_TTL_SECONDS to the import, so the import line is `import { DEFAULT_PORT, REGION, CACHE_TTL_SECONDS } from "./settings.js";`, and change the console.log line to `  console.log("Listening on port " + DEFAULT_PORT + " in " + REGION + " (ttl " + CACHE_TTL_SECONDS + "s)");`.
5. deploy/deploy.ps1: change `$Port = 8080` to `$Port = 9090`, add the line `$Ttl = 600` directly after it, and change the Write-Host line to `Write-Host "Déploiement terminé sur le port $Port"`.
6. data/regions.csv: change the port of the ZH row to 9090 and add the row `SP,São Paulo,8083` at the end of the file.
7. locales/de.yaml: change port_label to `"Anschluss 9090"` and add the line `ttl_label: "Gültigkeit 600 s"` as the new last line. This file has no newline at the very end today, and it must still have none after the edit.
8. README.txt: change every 8080 to 9090 (there are three).
9. config/billing.toml: in [service] change port to 9090, add the line `ttl = 600` directly after the port line, and change label to `Rechnung für Zürich – Altstadt` (with an en dash). Everything else, including the euro sign in fee, stays.
10. docs/notes.txt: change 8080 to 9090 and add the line `TTL: 600 seconds` as the new last line. Like locales/de.yaml, this file has no line ending at the very end today and must have none after the edit.
11. scripts/start.sh: change `PORT=8080` to `PORT=9090`, add the line `TTL=600` directly after it, and change `export PORT` to `export PORT TTL`.
12. web/index.html: change the title to `Café Zürich – Bestellung` and change both 8080 to 9090.
13. config/mac.cfg: change `port=8080` to `port=9090` and add the line `ttl=600` directly after it. The lines of this file are separated by a lone carriage return, and the file ends with one.
14. data/prices.tsv: change the port column of both data rows to 9090 and add the row `A3<TAB>Éclair<TAB>5.20<TAB>9090` at the end (`<TAB>` is a tab character, as in the other rows). The tab characters in the existing rows must stay tabs.
15. config/win.inf: change `Port=8080` to `Port=9090`, add the line `Ttl=600` directly after it, and change `Name=Gateway Zürich` to `Name=Gateway Zürich Nord`.
16. CHANGELOG.md: change `- Port 8080 documented` to `- Port 9090 documented` and add the line `- Cache ttl of 600 seconds` directly after it. This file has mixed line endings on purpose: every line you do not change keeps its own ending, and a new line gets the same ending as the line directly before it.
17. docs/todo.txt: change `- Open port 8080` to `- Open port 9090` and add the line `- Set ttl 600` directly after it. The file ends with an empty last line (two line endings in a row at the end), and that empty line must stay.

config/other.ini belongs to another team and also contains 8080. Do not change it, and do not change locales/en.yaml, scripts/stop.sh or docs/archive/old-readme.txt, which also mention 8080 and are not part of this change. Do not leave backup or temporary files in the project.
